note.title: Variables, controls, reliability and validity
note.overview: Strong practical design identifies variables precisely and distinguishes consistency, validity and accuracy.
learningGoals: Recall the precise Year 8 vocabulary for variables, controls, reliability and validity.
Apply the knowledge rather than relying on recognition alone.
Use the command word and include every required scientific point.
mustMemoriseRules: IV is changed; DV is measured; control variables are kept constant.
Reliability concerns consistency of repeats; validity concerns whether the method tests the intended relationship; accuracy concerns closeness to the true value.
An anomaly does not fit the pattern and should be investigated.
